title: SDLC Task Research v1
description: The task-specific payload for bounded research. It has exactly two root properties: intent defines the questions and sources to investigate, and result records findings, unresolved questions, recommendations, and evidence limitations. The common task envelope owns processing state, task workflow status, identity, routing, dependencies, and schema dispatch.
$comment: Research results distinguish observations from unresolved uncertainty and recommendations. Impact and confidence are integer scores from 0 through 100. A research result does not silently apply a recommendation, change a parent task, or prove claims beyond its recorded sources and evidence limitations.
